summary: Added headless cmd/fontgallery tool, TestFontGolden snapshot tests with -update flag, extended TestBlockRowWidths, and added TestCharsetCoverage test.

Re-authored the default 'block' font as a clean, legible, medium-weight 5-row static glyph map covering the full uppercase charset (added missing ; & %), migrating it onto the shared NewBlock code path (compact already uses it; heavy will follow) and retiring the legacy RenderString/StringWidth/letters machinery + orphaned font_test.go. Provenance: cfonts block/simpleBlock checked but GPL-3.0 (incompatible with plaqq MIT), so glyphs hand-authored, not transcribed. Block width+coverage+golden green; gallery eyeballed. heavy/compact still red by design (separate laps).
